text:
Alex C: Heads-up — product wants a Dispatch metrics dashboard that surfaces continuous-batching behavior and route saturation per-tenant. Can platform/runtime folks weigh in on feasible inputs?

Priya K: High level — we need: batch size distribution, queue wait times (p50/p95), fill-rate, and a saturation flag that triggers routing fallback. Also per-route and per-tenant breakdowns.

Jon P: +1. From runtime we'll need to emit histograms for batch_size and wait_ms, and a gauge for queue_depth per-shard. Do we have an agreed metric name scheme?

Maria G: Suggest names: dispatch_batch_size_histogram, dispatch_wait_ms_histogram, dispatch_queue_depth_gauge, dispatch_fill_rate_ratio. Keep labels: model, route, tenant_id, region, tier.

Sam P: Important: quotas affect observed saturation. We should expose quota_rejects_total and quota_throttle_count by tenant/route so dashboards can correlate.

Alex C: Good point. Product wants a single panel that flags "saturated" when fill_rate < 0.6 AND p95(wait_ms) > 200ms. Can we compute that in Grafana?

Jon P: Yes, with PromQL we can. Example panel query (rough):
```
(summarize(dispatch_fill_rate_ratio{job="runtime"} by (tenant_id, route))) < 0.6 and histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(dispatch_wait_ms_bucket[1m])) by (le, tenant_id, route)) > 0.2
```
We'll need runtime to expose the histogram buckets for wait_ms.

infra-bot: NOTE: New metrics must be paginated for cardinality. Recommend max 3 tenant tiers in high-res ingestion; fallback to aggregate for high-card tenants.

Maria G: +1 to cardinality constraints. We'll add a label "tenant_class" (small/medium/large) and default high-card tenants into aggregated "tenant_class=large" stream.

Priya K: UX ask: add a rollout toggle in Console that can enable per-tenant alerting on saturation (email/pager). We need an API to register alert hooks.

Sam P: That ties to quotas: if a tenant hits saturation, product wants automatic temporary quota bump to avoid hard errors while we route. Need guardrails — rate-limited, recorded in audit logs.

Alex C: Propose action items: 1) runtime: expose histograms and queue_depth gauge (Jon) 2) infra: confirm ingestion policy and tenant_class labels (Maria + infra-bot) 3) platform/console: design panel and rollout toggle + alert registration API (Priya + Sam) 4) SLO/alert threshold proposal doc (me).

Jon P: I can land the metric changes in the next runtime patch. I'll post metric names + example scrape config here once done.

Maria G: I'll draft ingestion constraints and a transformation rule to map tenant_id -> tenant_class for prom remote_write.

Priya K: I'll prototype the Console toggle UI and a minimal API (POST /alerts/register) to wire alerts to teams.

Sam P: I'll write the quota bump playbook and safe limits. Also add audit log entries whenever temporary bumps occur.

Alex C: Thanks. Let's sync in the eng-platform weekly tomorrow to review panels. If anyone needs mock queries or a sample dashboard JSON, ping me. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: new ticket created: #PLAT-3421 "Dispatch metrics dashboard + saturation alerts" assigned to eng-platform.
